question: Who are said to be present in relation to the māyā-born unmanifest?
premises: The unmanifest is described by several synonymous names as the cause of the guṇas.
It belongs to the domain arising from māyā.
All embodied knowers whose minds are stained by innate and adventitious impurity are associated with it.
inference: The māyā-born unmanifest is the locus associated with all impure embodied knowers.
uncertainties: The verse is syntactically compressed and continues into the next verse.
plain_english: These are synonymous names for the cause of the qualities, belonging to what arises from māyā; all the embodied knowers whose minds are stained by innate and adventitious impurity are there.
